original.target_description: Full original article not obtained. DOI landing page, Unpaywall, OpenAlex and LMU repository did not supply full paper. Author dissertation includes only an article citation placeholder, not the original paper.

replication.target_description: Replication section 3.3, printed p.946 (PDF p.4), confirms misclassification analyses and directs the reader to the Supplement. Supplied PDF p.2 contains introduction/methods, not misclassification results. No error category, factor term, or contrast identifies the requested test.

notes: Seven assigned misclassification targets have indistinguishable descriptions within their page groups. Input order was not used to assign statistics. Main paper available; supplement acquisition returned HTTP 403 and was not retried. Missing supplement is not treated as entire-paper unavailability. The authors’ overall emotion-recognition replication verdict was not substituted for a target-specific verdict on this response-time, control-task, or unidentified misclassification test. Replication contains AN and healthy-control groups, not a separate major-depression group. The original dissertation was retained separately as non-article provenance; original terminal miss records acquisition routes.
